## Description

Checks whether the deposit has Julia `Project.toml` and `Manifest.toml` files, and lists the packages the code uses. When `julia` is not installed, the script exits without doing anything.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/17_run_julia_scanner.sh <projectID>
```

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
- `ProcessJulia` - When `no`, the script exits immediately (the pipeline default is `no`).

## Outputs

- `generated/julia_toml_chks.md` - Which `.toml` files are present
- `generated/julia_pkgs.csv` and `.md` - Packages found by `tools/scan_pkg.jl`
